headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals edged the Detroit Tigers in a thrilling 3-2 victory, with Hao-Yu Lee leading the Royals' offense. In other action, the Washington Nationals took down the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-3 behind CJ Abrams' standout performance, while the San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels 9-2. The Toronto Blue Jays shut out the Boston Red Sox 6-0, with George Springer leading the charge.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Cody Bellinger, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the New York Yankees due to a left hamstring strain. Other players on the injured list include Shea Langeliers (Athletics), Mike Paredes (Minnesota Twins), Josh Jung (Texas Rangers), Spencer Arrighetti (Houston Astros), Juan Soto (New York Mets), Shawn Armstrong (Cleveland Guardians), and Tanner Banks (Philadelphia Phillies).

The Boston Red Sox made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring 3B Curtis Mead from the Washington Nationals in exchange for LHP Connelly Early. The Philadelphia Phillies also made a trade, acquiring CF Kameron Misner from the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, finalizing the score at 3-2. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a standout performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the charge at the plate. Abrams went 3-for-4 with a home run and 3 RBIs, while Foster Griffin earned the win and Clayton Beeter notched the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Dominate Angels in 9-2 Rout**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a convincing 9-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels, with Robbie Ray earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Place Cody Bellinger on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cody Bellinger, left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Curtis Mead in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead.
